info.title: Gym Tracker API
info.description: API documentation for Gym Tracker application

get.description: Display a listing of the resource.

get.summary: Get list of body part measurements
get.description: Display a listing of the resource.
Display a listing of the user's daily journals.

post.description: Store a newly created daily journal.

get.description: Display the specified daily journal.

put.description: Update the specified daily journal in storage.

delete.description: Remove the specified daily journal from storage.

get.description:
Display a listing of the user's exercises.

Retrieves a paginated list of exercises belonging to the authenticated user,
as well as global exercises (where user_id is null).
Supports filtering by name, type, and category, and sorting by name and created_at.

post.description:
Store a newly created exercise in storage.

Validates the request data and creates a new custom exercise for the user.

get.description:
Display the specified exercise.

Retrieves the details of a specific exercise.

put.description:
Update the specified exercise in storage.

Modifies the details of an existing exercise.
Only the user who created the exercise can update it.

delete.description:
Remove the specified exercise from storage.

Permanently deletes a custom exercise.
Only the user who created the exercise can delete it.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the exercise to delete

get.description:
Display a listing of the user's fasts.

Retrieves a paginated list of fasting records belonging to the authenticated user.

post.description:
Store a newly created fast in storage.

Validates the request data and starts a new active fast for the user.

get.description:
Display the specified fast.

Retrieves the details of a specific fasting record.

put.description:
Update the specified fast in storage.

Modifies the details of an existing fast, for example ending an active fast.

delete.description:
Remove the specified fast from storage.

Permanently deletes a fasting record from the user's history.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the fast to delete

get.description:
Display a listing of the user's goals.

Retrieves a paginated list of goals belonging to the authenticated user.
Supports sorting and including the related exercise.

post.description: Store a newly created goal in storage.

get.description: Display the specified goal.

put.description: Update the specified goal in storage.

delete.description: Remove the specified goal from storage.

get.description:
Display a listing of the user's habits.

Retrieves all active habits for the authenticated user, supporting
optional pagination.

post.description:
Store a newly created habit in storage.

Validates the request data and uses the CreateHabitAction to persist
the habit.

get.description:
Display the specified habit.

Retrieves a single habit by its ID, along with its most recent logs.

put.description:
Update the specified habit in storage.

Validates the request data and updates the existing habit model.

delete.description:
Remove the specified habit from storage.

Deletes the given habit model from the database.

get.description:
Display a listing of the sets for the authenticated user.

Retrieves a paginated list of sets belonging to the user's workouts.
Supports filtering by workout_line_id.

post.description:
Store a newly created set in storage.

Validates the request, ensures the user owns the associated workout line,
and saves the new set.

get.description:
Display the specified set.

Retrieves the details of a specific set if the authenticated user owns it.

put.description:
Update the specified set in storage.

Validates the request, applies updates to the set, and clears volume-related user statistics.

delete.description:
Remove the specified set from storage.

Deletes the set from the database and clears volume-related user statistics.

get.description:
Display a listing of the user's supplements.

Retrieves a paginated list of supplements belonging to the authenticated user.
Supports filtering by name/brand, sorting, and eager loading the latest log.

post.description:
Store a newly created supplement in storage.

Validates the request data and creates a new supplement record for the authenticated user.

get.description:
Display the specified supplement.

Retrieves the details of a specific supplement record, along with its latest usage log.

put.description:
Update the specified supplement in storage.

Validates the incoming request and modifies the details of an existing supplement.

delete.description:
Remove the specified supplement from storage.

Permanently deletes a supplement record from the user's inventory.

get.description:
Display a listing of the user's workouts.

Retrieves a paginated list of workouts belonging to the authenticated user.
Supports sorting (e.g., `-started_at`) and eager loading of relationships
such as `workoutLines`, `workoutLines.exercise`, and `workoutLines.sets`.

post.description:
Store a newly created workout in storage.

Validates the request data and creates a new workout for the authenticated user.
Dispatches a background job to recalculate user statistics after creation.

get.description:
Display the specified workout.

Retrieves the details of a specific workout, eager loading its lines, exercises,
and sets. It also batch-loads recommended values for the workout lines to
optimize performance.

put.description:
Update the specified workout in storage.

Validates the request data and updates the existing workout.
Dispatches a background job to recalculate the user's statistics
based on the updated workout data.

delete.description:
Remove the specified workout from storage.

Deletes the given workout and dispatches a background job to recalculate
the user's statistics, removing the impact of the deleted workout.

patch.summary: Reorder the exercises of a workout
patch.description:
Renumerote les exercices d'une seance depuis l'ordre soumis.

Un point d'entree a part plutot qu'un champ de plus sur `update` : la
page de seance ecrit par petites touches — une serie, une valeur — et
renvoyer la seance entiere pour deplacer un exercice se battrait avec
l'ordonnancement optimiste qui tient ces ecritures.

get.description:
Display a listing of the user's workout templates.

Retrieves a paginated list of workout templates belonging to the authenticated user.
Supports sorting and eager loading of relationships.

post.description:
Store a newly created workout template in storage.

Validates the request data and creates a new workout template for the user.

get.description:
Display the specified workout template.

Retrieves the details of a specific workout template, including its lines, sets, and exercises.

put.description:
Update the specified workout template in storage.

Modifies the details of an existing workout template.

delete.description:
Remove the specified workout template from storage.

Permanently deletes a workout template.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the workout template to delete
